Each keeps a short rationale inline (`exploration converged on Alacritty + herdr`). The rendered Brewfile confirms all three now appear as comments while `alacritty` and `dbeaver-community` stay active.

A couple of things I deliberately left alone — flag if you want them changed too:

- **`scripts/upgrade_tools.sh` `cat_warp`** — that's the *upgrade* path (Linux apt-only), not install. It self-guards on `command -v warp-terminal`, so it's a harmless no-op once Warp isn't installed. Install vs upgrade is split on purpose in this repo, so I didn't touch it.
- **Aliases / keybindings / alacritty config references** (`10_aliases.sh`, `tmux/keybindings.conf.tmpl`, etc.) — those are usage integrations, not installers.

Note these are commented, not deleted — since `brew bundle` doesn't uninstall, any already-installed Warp/cmux/Superset stay on disk; remove them manually with `brew uninstall --cask warp cmux superset` if you want them gone.
